description: Add or replace a domain model (class/interface/DTO) in a project's domain catalog. Call this whenever you create or significantly change a TypeScript interface, class, Mongoose schema, Zod schema, or DTO while implementing a feature. Provide every field with its type, required flag, constraints, and the architectural layer (data | dto | domain | response | request | event | other). The model is upserted by name — re-calling with the same name updates it.

addedBy.description: Agent or user identifier who is adding/updating this model (defaults to "system-mcp")

defaultValue.description: Default value expressed as a string (e.g. "false", "[]", "null")

type.description: TypeScript-style type string: "string", "number", "boolean", "Date", "string[]", "ObjectId", or any custom class name

layer.description: Architectural layer: data=DB document, dto=transport, domain=domain object, response/request=API shapes, event=async message, other.

name.description: Domain model name (e.g. "UserDocument", "ProjectDto"). Case-sensitive — acts as the unique key for upsert.

projectId.description: The _id of the project that owns this domain catalog

usedByUseCases.description: List of use case IDs that reference this model

name: upsertProjectDomainModel
